sources.author: William Lilly

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Mercury and Moon placement/aspects analyzed in combination
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Mercury is used for intellectual/rational qualities; the Moon for sensory/emotional qualities.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Specified planetary station/orientation involving Mercury or Venus
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Interest in hidden matters, the unknown, mysteries, and philosophical or occult activities is discussed as a soul quality.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Specific configurations of planets in evening or beneath-horizon stations
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Reading omens is among the occupations/interests ascribed to certain configurations.
Interpreting dreams appears among interest/occupation examples.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Saturn combined with Venus in the relevant position
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Dispositions toward religious ceremonies, secret rites, initiations and mystical practices are ascribed.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Jupiter governing the soul in a favorable or unfavorable condition
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Piety and reverence are part of the described character, contrasted with superstition.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Jupiter and Mercury governing soul, with dignity/conditions
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Philosophical, religious, intellectual, teaching and rhetorical interests are listed.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Venus as ruler of soul in favorable conditions
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Favorable Venus description includes pleasant dreaming, art and enjoyment.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Venus with Mercury in honorable conditions
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Interest in art, beauty, poetry and learned pursuits is described.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Signs classified as bicorporeal influencing the relevant soul rulers
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Musical tastes and versatility/changeability are mentioned.

claim_anchors.section_locator: §13 zodiac signs and Moon; printed pp.335,361–363
claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Bicorporeal sign class or lunar orbital phase/position
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Change of mind and versatility are attributed to certain zodiacal/lunar conditions.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Mercury in honorable condition governing soul
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Intellectual inquiry into nature, invention, calculation and pursuit of mysteries are described.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Solstitial sign class affecting soul rulers
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Attention to gods and divinatory interests are included in sign-based character claims.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Ninth house as a general topic; not an individual natal rule by itself
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Religious people, clergy, books, learning and foreign journeys are assigned to the ninth house.
Dreams and visions are named among ninth-house matters.

claim_anchors.section_locator: p.55 Ninth House paragraph, second section
claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Jupiter placed in the ninth house
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Lilly describes Jupiter in the ninth as associated with a devout religious disposition.

claim_anchors.traditional_chart_condition_or_topic: Tenth house general topic, not an individualized event prediction
claim_anchors.source_claim_paraphrase: Trade, profession, authority and public office are designated tenth-house topics.

proposed_modern_phenomenology.relevance: An optional new phenomenology construct; aesthetics and piety are only adjacent traditional claims.
Surprise reactions are not the same as intellectual curiosity or dispositional changeability.
Traditional versatility/change-of-mind language does not specify a Eureka moment or a life revision.
Devotion/ritual disposition is separate from experiencing external guidance.
Interpreting omens does not provide a measurable rate of noticing meaningful coincidences or an inference of supernatural causation.
Traditional role, religion and vocation labels do not measure personal sense of meaning or social impact.

scope_limits.covered: Ptolemy Tetrabiblos III.13 and Lilly Christian Astrology house introduction printed page 55.
scope_limits.not_covered: All of Lilly Book III natal judgements, full Hellenistic and Jyotish corpora, full Dariot rules, horary/natal rule interactions, predictive validity or frequencies calibrated against populations.
scope_limits.chart_directness: Distinguish a topic merely assigned to a house, a conditional character claim, and a modern subjective item. No full natal chart or probability calculation is provided.
scope_limits.astrology_status: Claims are historical conventions, not evidence that planetary positions accurately predict traits.
scope_limits.measurement_status: Optional phenomenology items are unvalidated development questions and cannot be assigned chart-supporting polarity from these sources.
scope_limits.existing_survey_version: scenario-bank-v7.0-20260922; no participant data or questionnaire implementation modified

migration_plan.prospective_validation_gate: Freeze each actual chart predicate, source rule, candidate instrument and independent null controls before accessing untouched person's answers. Compare to conventional psychological baselines.
